props.summary: Eight-bit fallback-history mask shared by DFCO rotating release and one-shot scheduler0002c13c. Handler0002be40 clears the entire pending event mask, then ORs it into history and decrements ffff1937 when the count and aggregate inhibit ffff22e0 are both nonzero. Bounded 7mfk entry 00054c54..00054cc6 takes N=uint8(R6) and the raw cursor byte ffff221e. N=0 leaves all RAM unchanged and writes zero at SP+12/SP+16. For N>0, C0=min(cursor,5), C=(C0+N)%6; the loop visits successive slots and accumulates their masks from ROM8[00022695+slot]. Its accumulator is the OR of the next min(N,6) slot masks; N>=6 gives 0x3f. It stores C at ffff221e, ORs the accumulator into ffff20b5/ffff157e/ffff16fe and clears those bits at ffff1935. Signed MOV.B scratch registers and unsigned byte stores are explicit. For N>0 it saves incoming R9 at SP, writes N at SP+12 and the accumulator at SP+16, and restores R9. The boundary is 00054cc8 before the ROM flag check, duration helper and one-shot scheduler. The preceding mode/lead decision, pending-mask publication, later calls, other writers, physical channel mapping and hardware retain separate evidence.

props.summary: Multipurpose bitfield. Bit 0 is an alternate enable input to FUN 000bc9e4 and forces scheduled value 1000 in ATU-II one-shot scheduler 0002c13c. Within P030, coordinator 00082c8a is the only bit-6/7 writer. Its successful common-gate path sets bit 6 and, because stock ROM8[00008afc].bit3 is set, also sets bit 7. Every failed prerequisite clears both bits. Bit 7 gates snapshot matching, auxiliary monitor state, detection-core accumulation, a five-channel helper, and all three revolution windows. FUN 000c2152 reads bit 0 at 000c215a (tst #1; bf) and drives the fixed 60/50 percent exhaust test fractions while it is set and the computed duty words while it is clear; FUN 000cd75c clears bit 0 at 000cd76e while programming the ATU-II channel-7 cycle registers. Memory task 000cd85c is the only setter of bit 0: it executes or #1 at 000cdd4e (cmp/eq #3 at 000cdd40) for request 3 of manufacturer diagnostic service 0xa0, whose handler 000306f8 copies the request byte ffff8005 into ffff40be at 000309ca and sets pending flag ffff41de bit 0 at 000309d6; scheduler task 0002e8d2 runs the memory task with that request while the flag is set.

The five external bit-7 readers listed here are exhaustive. When bit 7 is clear, the coordinator and consumers reset their P030 working state; FUN 000872d0 resets all three revolution counters.

props.summary: Pending one-hot channel mask of the delayed injection start. Sequencer 00054a44 writes ROM8[00022695 + slot] for the slot accepted on the current engine event and zero when no slot is accepted; engine-event driver 00028ea2 seeds it during the start phase. Compare-match handler 0002be40 fires it through one-shot scheduler 0002c13c, and the sequencer fires it on the next event when ffff84ec.bit7 is still set.
note: Slot masks at 00022695 are 02 04 08 10 20 01. Channel bit k drives the injector of cylinder k + 1: Power Balance service 0x30 IOLID 0x0c replaces the same six-channel mask bit for bit and the Nissan-family profile assigns bits 1..32 to cylinders 1..6. The assignment is not measured electrically.

Bounded 7mfk entries 00054d06, 00054bdc and 00054c0e execute the accepted lookup, zero-lead-delta selection and negative-lead-delta clear. The direct lookup requires slot 0..5 and uses ROM8[00022695+slot]. Zero-delta selection clears the pending byte, computes next = cursor+1 for unsigned cursor <5 and 0 otherwise, and accepts only slot==next; acceptance updates cursor and the pending mask. Negative-delta entry clears only the pending byte. Full unsigned cursor and slot contexts do not imply service reachability. Earlier mode exits, positive-delta catch-up, other calls, complete sequencer execution and MMIO retain separate evidence.

The complete natural 00054a44 dispatcher executes its real selector, one-shot and programmer calls. The enabled entry follows the optional trigger setup. Equal lead accepts only the next cursor matching the staged slot; negative lead clears pending. Positive lead accumulates the exact ROM masks across every advanced cursor, updates queue/history, calls mode3 selection and one-shot, then publishes the final slot mask. The programmer argument is 4*unsigned8[ffff2333] or52 underffff4251.bit0 and wraps in the callee. All register state,192 frame bytes,64k RAM and declared alias neighbors are checked. chain_props.summary: Deceleration, RPM, vehicle-speed and overtemperature producers form software inhibit maskffff22e0 through coordinator0004ed88 and the runtime replacement. Bounded main RPM0004f282 selects unsigned activation/release pairs, loads delay only on a new arm, retains an existing arm counter and publishes the complete state byte. 1.note: With snapshot ffff2458.bit5 of upstream DFCO mode bit ffff2459.bit5 clear, 0004fbe2 requests no cut and 00050018 returns inhibit class 1.

2.note: On a rising edge (previous ffff245a.bit5 clear, coarse speed >= 4) 0004fbe2 requests cut when ffff11b3 > Entry threshold, x*25 RPM by coolant.

3.note: While the mode bit is held, 0004fbe2 compares ffff11b3 with the Hold threshold, x*25 RPM by coolant; a higher threshold needs more RPM to cut.

4.note: Cut request is 1 only while RPM/25 ffff11b3 is strictly above the selected threshold; 00050018 compares the same byte with the restore thresholds.

5.note: 00050018 interpolates Full Restore 0x12818 by coolant into lower threshold ffff16aa, RPM/25, after runtime floors and offsets.

6.note: 00050018 interpolates Intermediate Restore 0x1298C by coolant into upper threshold ffff1778, RPM/25, after runtime floors and offsets.

7.note: The class of RPM-drop byte ffff106a at 0x11CB5 = [4, 8, 12] selects restore floor 0x1299C = [36, 48, 54, 62] RPM/25 (900..1550 RPM).

8.note: ffff11b3 <= ffff16aa returns full-restore class 3; entry from idle needs class 0, so a higher threshold vetoes DFCO up to a higher RPM.

9.note: Below coarse speed 4, ffff16aa < ffff11b3 <= ffff1778 returns intermediate class 2; stock moving branches do not compare ffff1778.

10.note: 000503e0 steps idle, entry delays, full cut, and exit delay; table 0x2371C gives D = 00, 00, 15, 3F, 15 and 0004ed88 forms P = G | D | C.

13.note: Active main cut bit ffff2497.bit2 is one of the 15 global Booleans, so 0004ed88 sets G = 0x3F for all six channels.

14.note: Readiness bit 4 sets when accumulator ffff16a6 reaches ROM16[0x911C] = 381; any failed entry gate clears ffff16a6 and bits 3..5.

15.note: Each 100-count expiry adds lookup(0x124D2 at clamp((ffff11bc - 160) / 2, 0, 255)) - 128 to ffff16a6; stock step 0 at <= 2000 RPM, 127 at the limiter.

16.note: With readiness set and coarse speed ffff110e = 0, RPM/50 ffff11ae >= ROM8[0x85D9] = 36 (1800 RPM) sets bit 5; it clears below 30 (1500 RPM).

17.note: Stationary cut bit ffff247f.bit5 enters the same global Boolean group and becomes a full 0x3F mask.

18.note: With RPM gate ffff24a7.bit5 clear, bit 0 arms at coarse speed >= 93 and holds at >= 91 (candidate 186 and 182 km/h); stock delay ROM8[0x8CAF] is 0.

19.note: Active vehicle-speed cut bit ffff24a6.bit0 is a global Boolean and makes G = 0x3F.

20.note: P1217: raw coolant ffff1071 >= ROM8[0x8D15] = 190 sets, >= 180 retains; bit 5 also needs 1900/1700 RPM hysteresis and ffff2458.bit5 clear.

21.note: Overtemperature fuel-inhibit bit ffff41f2.bit5 is a global Boolean and makes G = 0x3F.

22.note: While service 0x30 IOLID 0x0C is active, 00050a34 returns Power Balance mask ffff2b2c in place of P; the ETC-fault mask A is ORed after it.
